answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Clockmaker pendulum proof stamped by the timekeepers guild. It demands each pendulum is a dated bench test plus a signed workshop log, so a farm must build a hundred real clocks by hand, and the copper is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The mesa is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk. The cipher is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
